Name: Madqueenmomo's Portraits part 1
Author: madqueenmomo
Description:
By popular demand on tumblr,
[url=http://madqueenmomo.tumblr.com/]Madqueenmomo's[/url] portraits are now open to the public.
The current Batch includes Abigail, Bouncer, Caroline, Dwarf, Gil, Grampa, Gunther, Jas, Krobus, Linus, Marlon,  Mr. Qi, Pierre, Sandy, Shane, Vincent and the Wizard.
More Portraits will be posted at later dates.

How to use,
Drag files into your Stardew valley > Content > Portraits folder.


If you find any graphical problems i didn't notice please contact me via tumblr or at madqueenmomo@gmail.com

apologies for any typos and spelling mistakes.
